title: How Our Water Is Produced
description: From treatment at our factories to delivery at your door, our water goes through three main stages.

steps.title: Water Treatment
steps.description: Water is filtered and purified at our factories in Abijo and Bogije before it moves on to production.

image.alt: Entrance of a Starling Water factory building with the Starling Water sign above an arched doorway

steps.title: Bottling and Sealing
steps.description: The purified water is filled into bottles and pure water sachets, then sealed and packed for distribution.

image.alt: Water bottle icon on a Starling Water blue background

steps.title: Packing and Delivery
steps.description: Packed products are loaded onto our branded vans and tricycles for retail, wholesale and distribution customers.

image.alt: Starling Water branded delivery van with the company phone numbers and factory addresses
